selection: Original project source tree, headers, required assets and root README. Omitted unrelated labs, generated documentation, logs, compiled objects, VCS and OS metadata.

files.reason: Initialize the first keyboard packet before its initial OR. Actual game_main_loop first-Enter/timer movement regression fails original with independently poisoned automatic storage and passes defined zero; ordinary pause/return/confirmation close sequence remains intact.

Size two VRAM pages by row bytes instead of bits; clip inclusive width/height edges before writes, and continue remaining color channels when an earlier channel already matches. Actual allocation/page-spacing and guarded two-page pixel/color owner regressions independently reproduce each original error, including progressive color-only edge failure.

Clip each clear pixel to original background dimensions before reading its RGB bytes. Natural game-over cleanup can extend below the framebuffer; actual guarded-background owner test originally SIGBUS then preserves valid pixels and clips all edges after repair.

icon.kind: Original pinned game sprite centered on a matching flat palette

derivedAssets.kind: Unmodified actual browser gameplay canvas with moved doodler and scrolling platforms

controlsRationale: External auto-orientation panel exposes original arrow makes. Held Left/Right uses make-repeat for the original impulse/friction movement. Up Boost is a single original upward-velocity adjustment; Down remains on the arrow pad for menus and descent. Enter starts/restarts, ESC opens pause, menu arrows/Enter confirm authored exit. No pointer calibration, no physics/art/level/RNG changes. Boot argument115 preserves original800x600RGB24 mode.

nativeGameplay.demonstrated: ROOT viewed original doodler movement, Boost/climb and scrolling platforms, Pause/main menu and confirmation Quit with clean native library return. Separate current-APK untouched gravity reached original GameOver, then normal Enter/Up restarted a visible fresh doodler.
limitations: Representative platform play, natural loss/restart and cleanup verified. Full ascent, high score and long survival are not claimed.
